item.text:
**Assessment:** mostly yes, but with important outcome-based counterweights. Scholz’s 2024 fiscal and investment policy was rules-based and growth-oriented, yet Germany still ended the year in recession and political collapse, which weakened continuity and the practical investment climate.

| Direction | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | Other IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Support | German Stability Programme 2024 adopted | Federal Government | 2024-04-24 | https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/aktuelles/stable-financial-policy-2273918 | Scholz’s government said fiscal policy was moving from crisis management back to debt-brake compliance while still maintaining high investment and lifting growth potential. That is direct evidence for fiscal responsibility and long-term investment conditions. | 5B.3, 5B.1 |
| Support | Agreement on 2025 budget and growth initiative | Federal Government | 2024-07-05 | https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/service/archive/budget-2025-2298116 | Scholz presented the budget as combining security/stability with the debt limit, tax relief, social housing, infrastructure investment, and renewable expansion. This is broad-based, long-horizon investment policy rather than short-term spending for popularity. | 5B.3, 5B.1 |
| Support | Germany's Scholz working with industry to boost growth | Reuters | 2024-10-22 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/germanys-scholz-working-with-industry-to-boost-growth-3674390 | Reuters reported Scholz pushing lower bureaucracy, better investment incentives, affordable energy, digitalization, AI, and skilled labor. That supports a claim that he was trying to improve the long-term business and investment environment. | 5B.3, 5B.1 |
| Support | Scholz: AI Act and 5G security create safer environment for investment and user trust | Bundesregierung | 2024-09-05 | https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/service/newsletter-und-abos/bulletin/rede-von-bundeskanzler-olaf-scholz-2307122 | Scholz linked AI regulation and 5G security to a safer environment for investment and user trust, while also supporting broadband, chip manufacturing, and technology openness. This is strong evidence for protecting investment conditions in a modern, rules-based economy. | 5B.3, 5B.1 |
| Support | Scholz asks for legislative help for heavily indebted municipalities | Deutscher Bundestag | 2024-12-04 | https://www.bundestag.de/dokumente/textarchiv/2024/kw49-de-regierungsbefragung-1027922 | Scholz said heavily indebted municipalities should not be left alone and asked for a legislative proposal to help them. This supports subnational fiscal capacity and broader public investment conditions. | 5B.3 |
| Counterweight | Germany's GDP fell 0.2% in 2024 | Destatis | 2025-01-15 | https://www.destatis.de/EN/Press/2025/01/PE25_019_811.html | Germany contracted in 2024, which is direct outcome-based counterevidence against a strong claim of successful macroeconomic stabilization under Scholz. | 5B.3 |
| Counterweight | Scholz firing Lindner collapsed the coalition and triggered political chaos | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-11-06 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/explainergerman-coalition-collapses-what-comes-next-3706936 | The coalition collapse worsened uncertainty and weakened policy continuity late in 2024. That undercut stable investment conditions even if it was not itself a fiscal-policy violation. | 5B.3, 4B.10 |
| Counterweight | Scholz loses no-confidence vote, paving way for election | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-12-16 | https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/german-chancellor-scholz-loses-no-confidence-vote-paving-way-for-election-3773234 | The lost confidence vote confirmed year-end governing instability. This does not prove fiscal irresponsibility, but it is real negative evidence for macro stability and policy continuity. | 5B.3, 4B.10 |

Search gap: I found **no direct evidence** that Scholz tried to manipulate monetary policy, attack Bundesbank/ECB credibility, or interfere with central-bank independence. The available record is mostly about fiscal rules, public investment, and the deterioration caused by recession and coalition collapse.
